The cheapest product price does not tell you the cost of receiving the parcel. International freight, optional services and any destination charges need separate checks. This guide helps you prepare those checks without inventing a universal price per kilogram or a guaranteed delivery time.
01a2b4468776: Brazilian buyers often search for frete, peso volumétrico and rastreamento. These refer to three connected tasks: obtaining a shipping quote, understanding the weight used for charging and following the parcel after dispatch. Keep them in that order. A tracking number cannot explain an unverified quote, and an estimated shipping duration does not prove that customs processing has finished.

e33a442571ca: Before warehouse packing, some inputs may only be estimates. Label them clearly and keep the expected package shape realistic. A jacket can be light but bulky; a rigid box can increase dimensions even when its contents weigh little. If you are considering removing packaging, check that the item can still be protected adequately. A smaller box is useful only if it remains suitable for the contents.
3993cc3eeb08: Actual weight is the mass measured on a scale. Volumetric weight is a calculation based on the parcel's outer volume and a divisor specified by the route. The applicable charging rule may compare the two, impose a minimum or round the result. Read the route's own wording rather than assuming one formula applies to every Brazil service. The estimator is a starting point; final packing can change the inputs.
8f76cd9cff0b: For an illustrative calculation, suppose a packed parcel weighs 3 kg and measures 40 × 30 × 25 cm. Its volume is 30,000 cubic centimetres. Dividing by 6,000 produces 5 kg; dividing by 5,000 produces 6 kg. These are hypothetical comparisons, not confirmed divisors for a Brazilian route. If the relevant route charges on the higher result, the scale weight alone would understate the charging basis.
a9f8a4b1264b: If the same contents can safely fit in a 40 × 30 × 20 cm package, the volume becomes 24,000 cubic centimetres. The same illustrative divisors give 4 kg and 4.8 kg. Compare the resulting live quotes, including any packing charge, before deciding that repacking saves money. Do not translate a reduction in calculated kilograms directly into a fixed cash saving without the route's actual tariff.
154f901ce031: Use the same contents, destination, dimensions and packing choice for each route comparison. Record the quoted amount, currency, charging basis, item restrictions and what the estimate includes. If one route accepts your items and another does not, their prices are not interchangeable choices. A route name or a social-media recommendation alone does not establish that the route is available for your current parcel.
a49263f465a5: Treat a displayed delivery estimate as planning information, not a personal guarantee. Ask what stage the estimate covers if that is unclear. Seller dispatch, warehouse processing, international transport, customs handling and local delivery are separate events. A delay before the parcel reaches the international carrier cannot be evaluated only against an advertised international transit range.
9ddf4c189cf9: Correios advises that imported shipments need the recipient's CPF information and that the recipient name should match the registration with Receita Federal. Check the current official guidance and the fields required by the selected shipping service. Enter personal details only in the appropriate official or service account. Do not put a CPF, full address or payment record into a public product spreadsheet.
11389c979d15: Import charges and procedures depend on the applicable rules and shipment details. This guide does not provide a fixed Brazilian tax rate or assume that a Hoobuy parcel belongs to a particular tax programme. Consult Receita Federal and the actual carrier for the current requirements. Keep purchase evidence and an accurate contents record so that any request for supporting information can be answered from real documents.
95854d137b12: For postal shipments handled by Correios, use the official Minhas Importações service to check notices and required actions. Identify the carrier from the parcel record and the actual tracking handoff before deciding which portal should show an update.
aa789b4cdbbb: The seller's delivery within China and the international parcel to Brazil are different journeys. Save the domestic tracking number against the purchased item, then save the international number against the packed parcel. If several items are consolidated, record which warehouse items belong to that parcel. This avoids reading a seller's domestic delivery scan as confirmation that the international shipment has arrived.
6c8777897591: When a new tracking number appears, check the carrier and the latest event on its official tracking page. A number being created is not the same evidence as physical carrier acceptance. Include the parcel number, last event and relevant date in a private support request instead of asking several parties to reconstruct the entire history.
12a190645a4d: Check whether the tracking or import portal requests a document, correction or payment. Follow the current official notice and its stated deadline. Open the official portal directly instead of using an unexpected payment message as your only source. Receita Federal offers an international-purchase status service for eligible shipment records; the required identifiers should be entered there privately, not posted in a comment or shared sheet.

afc7177bd63b: This guide explains how to build that budget and reconcile later changes. It does not publish a universal Hoobuy service-fee percentage, payment rate or shipping price: those figures need to be checked in the live account and route quotation. The examples below are invented arithmetic examples, clearly labelled, so you can replace every amount with your own confirmed values.
161ce7f7ea72: Open the original listing and select the intended size, colour and quantity. A low price on a product card may refer to another option, a minimum quantity or an older listing. Record the amount and currency after selecting your option. Keep the seller URL and a dated screenshot together. This gives you a useful reference if the agent later asks you to approve a difference.
569c61972cfa: Use one currency for the working budget. If the seller charges in CNY and your payment account uses another currency, preserve both amounts instead of replacing the original. 2bbea755a10f: Do not count a charge twice. If a checkout total already includes domestic delivery, either record that inclusive total or separate its components, but do not add the delivery line again. Apply the same rule to a payment fee included in the amount charged to your card. When the description is unclear, ask what the quoted amount includes before treating it as the final total.
e5b72a8fd23b: Suppose two selected products cost CNY 180 and CNY 120. Assume domestic delivery is CNY 12, an optional service costs CNY 8, the separately displayed payment cost is CNY 10, and the international shipping estimate is CNY 190. These are example inputs, not Hoobuy prices or a quote for any destination. The known subtotal is CNY 520: 180 + 120 + 12 + 8 + 10 + 190.
1ad4a7711457: If the final shipping amount becomes CNY 220, the subtotal becomes CNY 550. The increase is CNY 30, not a second CNY 220 payment to add on top of the estimate in your cost ledger. Keep an estimated column and a final column so the replacement is explicit. Any unconfirmed destination charge remains outside this subtotal and should be marked as pending.
731711609bc6: The purpose of this example is to make the missing information visible. A budget of CNY 520 with destination costs unconfirmed is different from an all-inclusive promise of CNY 520. You can reserve your own contingency for uncertainty, but identify it as your planning buffer. It is not an additional platform fee and should not be presented as one.
e20bb283ab5e: Before warehouse packing, the total weight and outer dimensions may be estimates. Packaging can change both. A bulky but light item may produce a different chargeable weight from a compact item with the same scale weight. Compare the selected route's actual rules, including its volume divisor, minimum charge, rounding and eligible item types. Do not assume that every route prices only the physical kilograms.
cf4c3cf53dec: For a purely mathematical example, a 40 × 30 × 25 cm parcel has a volume of 30,000 cubic centimetres. A divisor of 6,000 gives 5 kg of volumetric weight; a divisor of 5,000 gives 6 kg. Neither divisor is a promise about your route. Use the live route rule, then check whether its price also includes additional services or surcharges. Record the dimensions before comparing two estimates.
9473f621e970: If several payment methods are offered, compare the same order and currency at the same time. Record the order amount, any separately displayed payment cost, the exchange conversion and the final amount payable. A low advertised percentage is not enough to compare methods when conversion and fixed charges differ. Stop before confirming a payment if a line cannot be explained from the checkout screen.
ed93325990ec: A wallet top-up and a purchase paid from that wallet are related movements, not necessarily two separate purchase costs. Record money entering the wallet as funding, then record the order payment against the relevant order. For a refund, distinguish a requested refund, a wallet credit and money returned to the original payment method. Count the settled amount rather than assuming that every pending credit is already available.
ee63088915f3: Choose additional photographs, measurements, packing or other services because they answer a specific question or protect a specific item. Write the question first. 33363a6fa5b7: Save the initial order total, any requested adjustment, your response and the final settled amount. Compare the requested difference with the underlying change instead of sending another payment just because a status label looks urgent.
d7b5e4553f35: Before paying for a parcel, reconcile the item list, optional services, packed measurements, selected route and amount due. After shipment, update the final column when the account records a settlement or refund. Keep the original estimate for comparison. This lets you see whether the main uncertainty came from the product option, packing, currency conversion or the route itself.
